measurement: Installed certificate-signed app; monotonic timing logs from production code.
baseline: The preceding installed build raised a native tap-format exception: 44.1-kHz hardware versus a cached 48-kHz output bus. No valid controlled baseline latency was obtained.
scope: Four library-button starts using the actual selected microphone. Start cue timing includes destination capture, history setup and sound dispatch, but excludes the Control gesture's 100-ms chord-detection delay and physical sound playback latency. Two quiet recordings were finalized with no recognized words; two were kept as interrupted audio. Quiet finalization timings do not predict speech transcription or clipboard delivery latency. No speech accuracy or universal latency guarantee is made.
